name: Sector Performance During High Inflation Regimes
description: Identifies periods where US YoY CPI inflation exceeds 4% and measures sector ETF performance (XLE, XLK, XLF, XLP) during those regimes. YoY CPI computed as 12-month % change of CPIAUCSL. High inflation regime = YoY CPI > 4%. Computes cumulative returns per inflation episode, average across episodes per sector. Outputs: cross-sectional bar chart ranking sectors by avg return during inflation, event markers at regime entries, summary table with avg/median return, hit rate, episode count, and avg duration.
source:
# --- Sector Performance During High Inflation (YoY CPI > 4%) ---
# Loads CPIAUCSL monthly, computes YoY change, identifies inflation regimes,
# measures sector ETF cumulative returns during each episode.

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()()
cpi_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="CPIAUCSL")
cpi = ffill(cpi_raw.result)

# YoY CPI: 12-month % change (~252 trading days for monthly data ffilled to daily)
# CPIAUCSL is monthly ffilled to daily; use calendar_shift for exact 1Y lag
cpi_1y_ago = calendar_shift(cpi, "1Y")
yoy_cpi = (cpi - cpi_1y_ago) / cpi_1y_ago

# --- Inflation Regime Detection ---
# High inflation = YoY CPI > 4% (0.04 in decimal)
threshold = 0.04
is_high_inflation = yoy_cpi > threshold
regime_entry = crossover(yoy_cpi, threshold)
regime_exit = crossunder(yoy_cpi, threshold)

# --- Daily Returns & Cumulative Return Within Regime ---
daily_ret = returns(src.c, period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)
growth = 1 + nz(daily_ret, fallback=0)

# Cumulative product within regime: reset at each regime entry
# Use barssince(regime_entry) to know how far into the episode we are
bars_since_entry = barssince(regime_entry)

# Rolling cumulative return since last regime entry using agg with window
# We need cumulative product that resets — use the pattern:
# cum_growth tracks (1+r) product from last entry
# When regime_entry fires, reset to 1
# Use valuewhen to capture the expanding cumulative product at entry points

# Expanding cumulative product of growth factor
cum_growth = cumulative(growth, agg=AggregationType.Product)

# Value of cum_growth at last regime entry
cum_at_entry = valuewhen(regime_entry, cum_growth, occurrence=0)

# Cumulative return since last entry = cum_growth / cum_at_entry - 1
regime_cum_ret = cum_growth / cum_at_entry - 1

# Only keep values during high inflation regime
regime_ret_active = where(is_high_inflation, regime_cum_ret)

# Capture the cumulative return at regime exit (end of episode return)
episode_ret = where(regime_exit, regime_cum_ret)

# --- Episode Duration ---
# Duration = barssince(regime_entry) at regime_exit
episode_duration = where(regime_exit, bars_since_entry)

# --- Hit Rate: positive episode returns ---
episode_positive = where(regime_exit, regime_cum_ret > 0)

# --- Timestamp for charts ---
ts = index().value

# --- Event Markers: Regime Entry ---
# YoY CPI at entry (display as %)
yoy_at_entry = yoy_cpi
# Number of sectors is always 4 (constant)
sector_count = 4

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Inflation Regime Start',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='YoY CPI', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Sectors Tracked', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(yoy_at_entry, sector_count, regime_entry)

# --- Bar Chart: Avg Cumulative Return Per Sector During Inflation ---
# episode_ret is sparse (only at regime exits), Mean aggregation gives avg across episodes
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Which Sectors Survive High Inflation?',
    x_axis_label='Sector',
    y_axis_label='Avg Episode Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    color_by_value=True,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Break-Even', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category='Inflation Regime Analysis',
    order=1
)(values=episode_ret)

# --- Summary Table: Per-Sector Statistics ---
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Sector Performance in High-Inflation Episodes',
    category='Inflation Regime Analysis',
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Sector Performance in High-Inflation Episodes',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Median Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Episodes', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Duration (days)', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    )
)(episode_ret, episode_ret, episode_positive, episode_ret, episode_duration)
